# ja-offline-business-tools

> Zero-cloud, 100% browser-local & Python stdlib offline business tools for PII redaction before AI chat prompts, 5-marketplace Japanese EC profit & GMROI calculation, and Oct 2026 Japan Invoice System (80% -> 70% deduction) arithmetic & T-Number check-digit verification.

## Live Free Browser Tools (Zero Data Sent, Strict CSP connect-src 'none')
- [All-in-One Offline Browser Tools Hub (JP / EN)](https://yatagarasu-lab.github.io/ja-offline-business-tools/)
- [1-Second Offline PII & API-Key Redactor + Local Restore](https://yatagarasu-lab.github.io/ja-offline-business-tools/#panel-pii)
- [5-Marketplace EC Breakeven, Net Margin & Annual GMROI Calculator](https://yatagarasu-lab.github.io/ja-offline-business-tools/#panel-ec)
- [Oct 2026 Japan Invoice 70% Deduction & T-Number Validator](https://yatagarasu-lab.github.io/ja-offline-business-tools/#panel-inv)
- [Zero-Call Free 3-in-1 Cash Simulators (Inheritance Tax / Incorporation & Invoice 70% / Local MEO)](https://yatagarasu-lab.github.io/ja-offline-business-tools/asp-sim/)
- [Primary-Source World History Anime & Daily Breaking-News Impact Media Hub](https://yatagarasu-lab.github.io/ja-offline-business-tools/media/)
